title: First Steps Helper: Adjustable Value -1 to +1
description: Booklet Section 10.4 helper mapping one coefficient knob over the full -1..+1 machine-unit range.

walkthrough.title: Create knob value k
walkthrough.text: PLUS1 drives P1, so P1.out is an adjustable value k in 0..1.

walkthrough.title: Map to full machine unit
walkthrough.text: P1.out is patched into two summer inputs and -1 is patched into a third, giving 2*k-1 before the final sign recovery.

walkthrough.title: Display the result
walkthrough.text: INV1 recovers 2*k-1 and OUT Y carries the adjustable -1..+1 signal.
